# OREXITY — Pakistan Mineral Investment & Advisory

> OREXITY is a private-sector platform connecting international investors with Pakistan's mineral opportunities — market entry, due diligence, investment structuring, and project development in Gilgit-Baltistan.

## Core services
- [Investment Advisory](https://www.orexity.com/#advisory): opportunity screening, due diligence, structuring
- [Technical Intelligence](https://www.orexity.com/#technical): geological exploration, modelling, QA/QC
- [Projects Portfolio](https://www.orexity.com/#projects): Markhor 1, Markhor 2, Ketu 1, Rakaposhi 1
- [FAQ](https://www.orexity.com/#faq): common investor questions

## Key facts
- Focus: Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan
- Commodities: Copper, Gold, PMG, Polymetallic, Lithium, Critical Minerals
- Frameworks referenced: JORC, NI 43-101, VALMIN
